description: The app's sales (Money › Sales in the dashboard): "refund" { saleId } — gives the WHOLE payment back in Stripe (Neblla's 1 % with it; a seller's sale is given back by the seller, with the developer's commission when it can be recovered) and takes the purchase back at once (the player loses it, credits and paid bookings go back, the app hears a "revoked" purchase and the refund webhook fires). A subscription is not refunded here (not_refundable, reason "subscription"): the developer refunds or cancels it in their Stripe dashboard, at the sale's stripeUrl. Money leaves the developer's account. The CSV downloads are in the dashboard (POST /api/backend/apps/:appId/sales/csv and /users/csv). The actions that only look (list, documents) are in neblla_sales_read.
name: neblla_sales
title: Sales
